# MiganCore

> MiganCore is an open-source Indonesian AI model project (2026): a small large language model (LLM) based on
> Qwen3-4B, fine-tuned with LoRA and served locally with Ollama, designed to abstain ("I don't know") instead
> of hallucinating. The project closed on 28 September 2026. This repository is its complete, sanitized
> research record, MIT-licensed.

Key facts:
- **Base model:** Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (Apache-2.0).
- **Served model:** migancore:0.14, a TIES merge of two LoRA adapters, GGUF Q4_K_M, research use only.
- **Evidence:** 41 model variants, 39 pre-registered experiments, a 36-question Indonesian hallucination
  benchmark (petak-jujur2), and 316 findings.
- **Measured result:** the served fine-tune fabricates on about half of must-abstain questions (49.9 %).
- **What reduced hallucination:** two layers that need no training.
  - A knowledge-boundary paragraph: out-of-scope fabrication 28.9 % → 8.9 %.
  - An abstention gate: 52.2 % → 33.9 %.
- **What did not work:** training the weights toward honesty (V16-JUJUR: 60.0 % vs a ≤ 50 % threshold).
- **Author:** Fahmi Ghani (fahmiwol@gmail.com).
